'---------------------------------- 'ANIMATION START '---------------------------------- Private Sub Display_AnimationStart()
End Sub '---------------------------------- 'DISPLAY CLICK '---------------------------------- Private Sub txt_Display_Click() Dim i As Integer Dim Message As String
On Error GoTo ErrHandler Set MainD = Application.ActiveDisplay Message = MainD.FullName
If MainD.ParameterFileName <> "" Then Message = Message & vbCrLf & "Parameter File: " & ThisDisplay.ParameterFileName Else If MainD.TagParameters.Count > 0 Then For i = 1 To MainD.TagParameters.Count Message = Message & vbCrLf & "Parameter #" & i & ": " & MainD.TagParameters(i) Next i End If End If
MsgBox Message Exit Sub ErrHandler: Application.LogDiagnosticsMessage "Error occurred in " & ThisDisplay.FullName & _ " Error # " & Err.Number & ": " & Err.Description, ftDiagSeverityError, ftDiagAudienceOperator End Sub
